payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort beacons by position, then DP over positions: dp[i] = max saved beacons up to coordinate i, transitioning based on power and previous positions.
payload.rationale: The solution uses sorting only to order beacons for linear scan. The core logic is 1D DP where state index is position, computing max saved beacons with recurrence dp[i] = dp[i-1] if no beacon, else dp[i-b-1]+1. This matches dp_1d_state.
